Shows Union and rebel troop positions in east-central Paulding County, Georgia. Relief shown by contours. Title and date from Stephenson's Civil War maps, 1989. Similar map appears in the U.S. War Dept.'s Atlas to accompany the official records of the Union and Confederate armies, 1891-95, pl. 48, no. 4. Oriented with north towards the lower left. Pencil on irregularly shaped sheet. In pencil at right: McPherson. In pencil at right: May 27. In pencil at lower left: 29. Imperfect: Fold-lined. Mounted on paper. Library of Congress.
